sentence: This project works to fill the gap in cybersecurity workers across government agencies.
This project plans a future study of undersea mining for critical minerals in the Arctic and its impacts.
This project studies how freezing and thawing change soil strength and builds a model that predicts freeze-thaw soil behavior.
This project holds a one-month summer institute on theoretical high-energy physics.
This project studies how tiny plastics move through coastal ecosystems and affect organisms and the food web.
This project builds statistical methods that find weak signals hidden in large sets of noisy data.
This project studies how the shapes and tiny holes of biomass particles affect how heat and gases reach them during gasification.
This project studies how space weather storms change the hydrogen in the upper atmosphere of Earth, using models and machine learning.
This project designs proteins that self-assemble into vesicles like cell membranes to learn how surface proteins move and interact.
This project uses archaeological, historical and modern data to study how beaver, muskrat and mink populations changed during the fur trade.
This project studies whether a hormone made by the adrenal gland helped shape the brain as humans evolved.
This project builds an automated tool that reads written problem-solving strategies in physics and gives feedback on them.
This project builds a toolbox of videos, datasets and tutorials on growing mammalian cells to make biologics.
This project studies how to protect wireless networks and robotic systems from attacks and how to detect malware with explainable methods.
